workbench.title: This Week's Schedule
workbench.description: Layered view of confirmed events and AI pending proposals

agent.title: Scheduling Agent
agent.subtitle: Proposals require approval before writing to calendar
agent.promptPlaceholder: Enter scheduling request, e.g. Block 2 hours on Thursday morning for study
agent.shortcutHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for new line

proposal.rejectedStatus: Proposal declined and removed from calendar view

app.empty: No saved events yet. Ask the agent to draft your first event.
app.title: Scheduling Agent
app.requestHint: For example: Schedule 45 minutes of study on 2026-10-20, not before 15:00 and finish by 17:00.
app.noMessages: Tell me what you want to schedule. I will show a draft for your approval.
app.noSources: No applicable preference records. Saved availability still applies.
app.checksPassed: Checked against saved availability, hard rules and calendar conflicts.
app.reviewHint: Review the interpreted constraints and proposed change before approving. Approval checks the current calendar again.
app.taskHint: Describe the actual work stages and dependencies to get grounded tags and complexity.
app.settingsHint: Scheduling stays inside these daily windows. Hard unavailable periods below are also excluded.
app.preferenceHint: The day and time fields define the rule. The description explains it. Replacing a record preserves its history and changes eligibility on the new effective date.
app.preferencesDate: Preference answers use the requested date, or today when no date is supplied.

reasons.superseded: Replaced by a newer effective record

errors.invalid_input: Check the dates, times and required fields.
